beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The book contrasts this with investigations involving activations, interventions, and causal hypotheses.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Even an informative intervention supports conclusions only within its assumptions and experimental scope.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: A growing map of internal behavior is not complete understanding of the whole system.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: This distinction makes the later chapters more useful than a promise that models can simply explain themselves.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: An agent's result can depend on retrieval, tools, memory, permissions, and surrounding software.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Explaining only the model may leave those consequential dependencies out of view.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The book follows explanation into trajectories, replay, multimodal evidence, and system level assurance.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Formal guarantees also apply within specified boundaries rather than proving universal reliability.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Readers learn to connect an observed result with the processes that produced it.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: That wider view returns the discussion to the original contract between an explanation and its audience.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The final movement develops explanations as inspectable hypotheses with explicit supporting evidence.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: A model update or changed environment can weaken an earlier explanation's validity.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The proposed architecture separates prediction, observation, explanation, validation, and presentation responsibilities.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: It asks what another process could inspect, query, or attempt to falsify.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: This is a research direction with design choices to examine, not automatic certification.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The reader gains a way to connect established methods with more checkable explanatory systems.
